[1] "You Have the Right to Remain Silent" is a song written by Brenda and Cal Sweat, and recorded by American country music group Perfect Stranger.
[2] The Right to Remain Silent is a play by Mark Fauser and Brent Briscoe that was adapted for a television film in 1996 starring Robert Loggia and Lea Thompson.
[3] Brent Briscoe (born May 21, 1961) is an American actor and screenwriter.
[4] Mark Fauser is an American actor, director, screenwriter, and producer who currently operates the independent film movie studio, Overlook Productions.
